## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavioral changes
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or workflow changes
- [ ] `chore`: Dependency updates or build adjustments

## Related Issues / Tickets
Closes #

## Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] Test suite passed locally (`pytest -v`)
- [ ] Linter checks passed (`ruff check app tests`)
- [ ] Static type checks passed (`mypy app`)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials committed (`.env`, `service_account.json`)
- [ ] Documentation / README updated if applicable
